title.instructions: Name the bounded Effigy outcome in a few words using repo language; no leading verb.

branchName.instructions: Use worker/<short-kebab-case-outcome> for implementation lanes. For other work, use a short kebab-case name. Do not invent type prefixes this repository does not use.

commitMessage.instructions: Use a short imperative subject, optionally with a Conventional Commit type and scope such as docs:, docs(handoff):, fix:, fix(init):, or deps:. Do not put the GitHub PR number in the subject.

pullRequest.instructions: Lead with the shipped outcome. Name governing docs or the worker handoff when one exists. List validation actually run and any unresolved items. Do not claim merge authority.
